subject: WRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1192 (w61d), PB3333. a) and c) verified earlier. b) (cite.py --check 14.9.51.4 'When an attempt is made to write outside the externally defined boundaries of the file' -> OK 33)): the boundary of a relative file is the host's maximum file size capped by the format at 2^32 pages of 4 096 bytes (Annex A.1 item 107, DOC-A.1-107, DESIGN-runtime-library 2.2.1.9). The keyed store engine meets it AT THE WRITE: a reservation past 2^32 pages (PagedFile.Reserve) or a page write the host refuses to grow the file for (HandlePageMedium.Write asks HostFile.IsFileSizeLimit: ERROR_FILE_TOO_LARGE / EFBIG, raised as MediumSizeLimitException and answered by PagedFile.TryWrite) is StoreStatus.Boundary, which RelativeConnector.Write and Rewrite answer '24' with the INVALID KEY branch, nothing released and the file as the previous statement left it (R1). A full medium is not the boundary: '30' at that statement. MEASURED: RRN 600 000 000 and RRN 2 147 483 647 are one leaf entry each ('00', golden pb1192 and unit); the refusal at growth answers '24' and the next OPEN reads the earlier records (unit). The key<1 / key>highest case is GR29 b)'s explicit '34' (governs over the general GR33 b); DOC-A.1-107 records the determination). A REWRITE whose record the host refuses to grow the file for answers the same '24'.
